messages:
sophie: Quick postmortem follow-up: turning remediation items into tests. Two-week sprint starts Mon. Need owners for regression promptset, load replay, chaos drill.
alex: I can own regression promptset. Will pull failing prompts and add to evals harness. Target Wed EOD.
maria: I'll own the load replay. Need infra for ephemeral runner and CI job. Drafting traffic profile Tue AM. cc @dylan
jordan: I'll handle the chaos drill and runbook. Plan: staging 10% canary then ramp, dry-run next Fri.
dylan: Infra can provision a 2-node ephemeral cluster and a CI job. Maria, send VU/hr and retention. Example: `k6 run --vus 3000 --duration 30m script.js --out influxdb`.
sophie: TL;DR actions added to board: alex Wed EOD, maria Tue noon, jordan Thu EOD, dylan Wed EOD. Add PR links to cards when ready.
alex: Pass/fail: replay P95 latency <200ms and error rate <0.5%. Will include bad-case prompts + baseline.
maria: Question: recorded replay or synthetic? Replay preferred but may need sanitization.
sophie: Prefer replay; fallback to synthetic matching token-size and session timings if sanitization is blocking.
ops-bot: Card created: "PMT: kv-eviction -> tests" assigned to sophie - https://boards.redwood.internal/pm/901 (automated)
jordan: Propose regression gate: KV-eviction incidence >0.1% over 24h or model-fallback rate >0.5% -> auto-fail rollout and page oncall.
alex: I'll add gating thresholds and expected metrics to the evals gating doc and open PR.
sophie: Standups Mon/Wed/Fri 11:00 for quick sync. Two-week retro after sprint. Ping me for traces or blockers.
